description: This file provides an API client for authentication-related actions such as login, signup, and logout, interfacing with a backend server via fetch calls. It manages user authentication workflows by sending POST requests to specific endpoints and processes responses accordingly.

methods.name: login({ email, password }, extraHeaders={})
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, returns user info and access token.

methods.name: signup({ email, password, full_name }, extraHeaders={})
methods.description: Registers a new user with email, password, and full name; returns user info and possibly an access token.

methods.name: logout(_, extraHeaders={})
methods.description: Logs out the current user, optionally using extra headers for authentication.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^export async function login({ email, password }, extraHeaders={}) {$/

ctags.name: signup
ctags.pattern: /^export async function signup({ email, password, full_name }, extraHeaders={}) {$/
